RMD consumes $37,736 of that headroom (fixed: subtract rmdRequired, not rmdSpendingPull). headroomAfterRmd ≈ $65,764, easily covers the $12k additional spending pull. withdrawalFromTraditional = forcedTrad ($50k, since spending $50k > RMD $37,736) + conv $30k = $80k.
